policy: All active application code has one maintenance/architecture/test contract independent of origin. Preserve or change by concrete behavior/ownership/dependency evidence.
ancestry: ADOPTED_SOURCES.json and DERIVED_SOURCES.json preserve verifiable origins; archived references never compile
vendors: External TinyXML2/PEGTL/Asio/MinHook sources remain pinned under third_party with original licenses
changes: One redfield namespace and include/redfield tree for all application modules
All regressions directly under tests; no adoption-derived test category
Record views separated from retired global service-store APIs
Registry policy reads the maintained hook configuration directly; global runtime_configuration shim removed
SessionRetirement centralizes pending LocalService handoff and cleanup ownership
retained: Current DLL exports,35 route bindings,seven hook targets,Online policy and finite/zero shutdown retry semantics
Generic allocator/PTD compatibility APIs remain explicitly under runtime; this refactor does not claim they are minimal or globally optimal
limitations: No complete new line-by-line semantic audit of all functions claimed
Structural unification does not prove absence of all inherited bugs
